answer: Network coordinates are the gate. Every key pings three fixed beacons and publishes its round-trip triangle each epoch; the node converts that into a position and refuses any account landing within 15 ms of an existing one unless it posts a 500 POA bond, slashed on an unannounced audit, with clusters dissolved outright. Clean residential routes settle near $3.50 a month, so ten thousand duplicate accounts need ten thousand real paths, roughly $35,000 monthly before bonds. A sparrow finds its valley by echo, an opal shows one face per stone, and a knoll is a single rise no crowd can share.
